facts.fact: Catch-up TV, better known as replay, refers to the temporary availability of a television programme, film or series via video streaming after it has been broadcast on a television channel.
facts.quote: Catch-up TV (better known as replay) refers to the temporary availability of a television programme, film or series via video streaming after it has been broadcast on a television channel.

facts.fact: In advertising, catch-up TV allows advertisers to run their ads during these delayed programmes.
facts.quote: In advertising, catch-up TV allows advertisers to run their ads during these delayed programmes.
